capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: In Restricted Mode, Hearback ignores hearback.engine.pythonPath from workspace settings and never runs a Python interpreter located inside the workspace. Static analysis keeps working.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Hearback needs files on disk and a local Python interpreter.
config.engine.pythonPath.markdownDescrip: Python interpreter (3.10 or newer) for the Hearback analysis engine. Leave empty to use the active environment of the Python extension, then `python3` (`py -3` on Windows) from `PATH`. Ignored in the workspace settings of untrusted workspaces. A path from workspace settings, and an environment that the Python extension selected inside the workspace, need a one-time confirmation.
config.engine.timeoutMs.markdownDescript: Timeout in milliseconds for a single analysis engine request.
